name: native-translations
description: Editor assets for the WP Native Translations plugin.

scripts.build: npm run build:editor-panel && npm run build:post-links && npm run build:language-switcher && npm run build:overview && npm run build:queue
scripts.build:overview: wp-scripts build src/overview/index.js --output-path=native-translations/build/overview && npm run build:overview-css
scripts.make-pot: node extract-js-i18n.mjs /tmp/wpnt-js.pot && wp i18n make-pot native-translations native-translations/languages/native-translations.pot --exclude=build,node_modules --merge=/tmp/wpnt-js.pot
